entities.name: Demetrius I of Georgia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Demetrius I, of the Bagrationi dynasty, was a Georgian monarch (mepe) who ruled the Kingdom of Georgia from 1125 to 1154 and again from 1155 until his death in 1156. He is also known as a poet.
